special_abilities.name: Flyby
special_abilities.desc: The death's head doesn't provoke an Opportunity Attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

actions.name: Brain-Rending Bite
actions.desc: m +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) Piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the start of the death's head's next turn.

special_abilities.name: Darklord Restoration
special_abilities.desc: If Ankhtepot dies, he revives with all his Hit Points in 1d10 weeks somewhere in Har'Akir.

special_abilities.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Domain)
special_abilities.desc: If Ankhtepot fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: Ankhtepot has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

special_abilities.name: Regional Effects
special_abilities.desc:
Har'Akir is altered by Ankhtepot's presence, creating the following effects:
Blistering Sun: Any outdoor area of Bright Light in Har'Akir is an area of extreme heat (see the Dungeon Master's Guide).
Closing the Borders: While in his domain, Ankhtepot can close or open the borders to Har'Akir at will. While the borders are closed, whirling sands fill the Mists surrounding Har'Akir. A creature that enters the Mists for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there takes 2d6 Slashing damage.
Control Undead: Undead of CR 5 or lower in Har'Akir have the Charmed condition and obey Ankhtepot's orders.
If Ankhtepot dies, these effects end immediately.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Ankhtepot makes four Negative Energy Burst attacks. He can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting to cast Power Word Stun.

actions.name: Negative Energy Burst
actions.desc: m,r +11, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. Hit: 26 (6d6 + 5) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Touch of Death (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: Ankhtepot touches one creature within 5 feet. If the creature has 80 Hit Points or fewer, it dies. Otherwise, it takes 52 (8d12) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
Ankhtepot casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 19):
At will: Dispel Magic, Divination, Mage Hand (hand is Invisible), Power Word Stun
1/day each: Animate Dead, Sunburst

legendary_actions.name: Death Strike
legendary_actions.desc: Ankhtepot makes one Negative Energy Burst attack.

legendary_actions.name: Hand of Fate
legendary_actions.desc: str DC 19, one Large or smaller creature Ankhtepot can see within 60 feet.  14 (2d8 + 5) Force damage, and the target is pushed or pulled up to 20 feet straight away or toward Ankhtepot.  Half damage only.  Ankhtepot can't take this action again until the start of his next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Sands of Time
legendary_actions.desc: Ankhtepot teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space he can see. cha DC 19, each creature in a 10-foot Emanation originating from Ankhtepot at his destination space.  11 (2d10) Necrotic damage, and the target magically ages 10 years.  Half damage only.  Ankhtepot can't take this action again until the start of his next turn.

special_abilities.name: Darklord Restoration
special_abilities.desc: If Azalin dies and his spirit jar remains intact, he revives with all his Hit Points in 2d10 days in the unoccupied space nearest his spirit jar. If Azalin's spirit jar is destroyed, he instead revives in 4d10 days in Castle Avernus in Darkon.

special_abilities.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day, or 5/Day in Domain)
special_abilities.desc: If Azalin fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

special_abilities.name: Siphon Spell
special_abilities.desc:
Azalin casts Counterspell in response to the spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting. If the target creature fails its saving throw against this Counterspell, Azalin steals knowledge of the triggering spell. For 1 hour or until Azalin takes this Reaction again, Azalin can cast that spell once, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.
At will: Counterspell

special_abilities.name: Regional Effects
special_abilities.desc:
Darkon is altered by Azalin's presence, creating the following effects:
Closing the Borders: While in his domain, Azalin can close or open the borders to Darkon at will. While the borders are closed, undead terrors fill the Mists surrounding Darkon. Whenever a creature enters the Mists, one Hostile Zombie Clot appears in a random unoccupied space within 30 feet of that creature.
Lord of the Dead: While in his domain, Azalin can cast Clairvoyance, requiring no spell components and using the same spellcasting ability as his Spellcasting action. When Azalin casts this spell in this way, he can place the sensor in any Undead in Darkon with an Intelligence of 6 or less, even if it is beyond 1 mile of Azalin. In addition, Azalin can speak through the Undead he placed the sensor in.
No Secrets: Whenever a creature in Darkon casts a spell using a level 5+ spell slot, Azalin becomes aware of that creature's name and location. A Nondetection spell blocks this effect.
If Azalin dies, these effects end immediately.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Azalin makes three attacks, using Eldritch Burst or Paralyzing Touch in any combination.

actions.name: Eldritch Burst
actions.desc: m,r +12, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. Hit: 31 (4d12 + 5) Force damage.

actions.name: Paralyzing Touch
actions.desc: m +12, reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) Cold damage, and the target has the Paralyzed condition until the start of Azalin's next turn.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
Azalin casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 20):
At will: Detect Magic, Detect Thoughts, Dispel Magic, Invisibility, Lightning Bolt (level 5 version), Mage Hand, Prestidigitation
2/day each: Animate Dead, Dimension Door, Modify Memory, Plane Shift, Scrying
1/day each: Chain Lightning, Finger of Death, Power Word Kill

legendary_actions.name: Eldritch Teleport
legendary_actions.desc: Azalin teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space he can see and makes one Eldritch Burst or Paralyzing Touch attack.

legendary_actions.name: Forbidden Knowledge
legendary_actions.desc: int DC 20, up to three creatures Azalin can see within 60 feet.  28 (8d6) Psychic damage, and the target has the Stunned condition until the end of Azalin's next turn.  Half damage only.  Azalin can't take this action again until the start of his next turn.

special_abilities.name: Podling Link
special_abilities.desc: The plant can see through and communicate telepathically with any of its podlings within 10 miles of it. When the plant dies, its podlings also die.

special_abilities.name: Rejuvenation
special_abilities.desc: If the plant dies, it revives with all its Hit Points in 1d10 days. This trait doesn't function if the plant is reduced to 0 Hit Points by Poison damage or its remains are sprinkled with salt.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The plant makes three Vine attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Entrapping Pod.

actions.name: Vine
actions.desc: m +7, reach 20 ft. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) Slashing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14) from one of four vines.

actions.name: Entrapping Pod
actions.desc:
str DC 15, one Large or smaller creature the plant is grappling.  The target is pulled into the plant's space, is no longer Grappled, and is trapped in the plant's pod. While trapped, the target has the Blinded and Paralyzed conditions, and it has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the pod. After 2d4 hours, the trapped target dies, and if it was a Humanoid, a Bodytaker Podling resembling it emerges from the pod.
A creature outside the pod and within 5 feet of the plant can take an action to make a DC 14 Strength (Athletics) check. On a successful check, the target is removed from the pod, falls in a space within 5 feet of the plant, and has the Prone condition. If the plant dies, the trapped target is no longer Blinded or Paralyzed and can escape from the pod using 5 feet of movement, exiting Prone.

reactions.name: Transfer Harm
reactions.desc: An attack roll hits the plant while a podling is within 5 feet of the plant.  The plant halves the damage it takes from that attack, and the podling takes the other half of the damage.

name: Bodytaker Podling
languages: Deep Speech plus one other language

special_abilities.name: Semblance of Life
special_abilities.desc: The podling is a physical copy of a creature digested by a Bodytaker Plant. The podling has Advantage on Charisma (Deception) checks made to pass as the digested creature. The podling melts into a slurry when it dies.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: m +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage.

special_abilities.name: Abduct
special_abilities.desc: The boneless needn't spend extra movement to move a creature it is grappling.

special_abilities.name: Compression
special_abilities.desc: The boneless can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

actions.name: Smother
actions.desc: m +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 12). Until the grapple ends, the target has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, is suffocating, and takes 7 (2d4 + 2) Bludgeoning damage at the start of each of the boneless's turns. The boneless can smother only one creature at a time. While grappling a target, the boneless can't take this action again.

name: Brain in a Jar
languages: telepathy 60 ft. understands Common plus three other languages but can't speak; telepathy 60 ft.

special_abilities.name: Detect Intelligence
special_abilities.desc: The brain magically senses the location of any creature within 300 feet of itself that has an Intelligence score of 3 or higher, regardless of interposing barriers.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The brain has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The brain makes two Disrupting Burst attacks.

actions.name: Disrupting Burst
actions.desc: m,r +6, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Psychic damage. The target can't take Reactions until the end of its next turn, and it has Disadvantage on saving throws to maintain Concentration until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Mind Blast (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: int DC 14, each creature in a 60-foot Cone.  14 (4d6) Psychic damage, and the target has the Incapacitated condition until the end of the brain's next turn.  Half damage only.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The brain casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):
At will: Charm Person, Detect Thoughts, Mage Hand
1/day each: Compulsion, Hold Person (level 3 version)

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The carrion stalker makes two Tentacle attacks and one Stinger attack.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.desc:
m +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) Piercing damage, and the carrion stalker attaches to the target. While attached, the carrion stalker can't make Tentacle attacks against other targets.
The carrion stalker can detach itself by spending 5 feet of movement. The target or a creature within 5 feet of it can detach the carrion stalker as an action.

actions.name: Stinger
actions.desc: m +5 (with Advantage if the carrion stalker is attached to the target), reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (2d6) Poison damage, and the target is subjected to the following effect. con DC 13.  The target has the Poisoned condition. While Poisoned in this way, the target is infested with a carrion stalker larva. If the target is still Poisoned in this way after 24 hours, the effect ends as the larva becomes a fully grown Carrion Stalker, which bursts from the target's chest and kills it.

actions.name: Silver Needle
actions.desc: m +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 1 Piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) Necrotic damage. If the target is a Humanoid not cursed by a carrionette, it is subjected to the following effect. cha DC 11.  The target is cursed for 1 minute. Until the curse ends, the target has the Poisoned condition, and its Speed is reduced by 10 feet.

actions.name: Soul Swap (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc:
cha DC 11, one Humanoid the carrionette can see within 15 feet that is cursed by its Silver Needle.  The carrionette possesses the target's body, and the target possesses the carrionette's body and has the Unconscious condition for 1 hour. While possessing another body, the carrionette and target retain their alignments; personalities; Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores; and languages known. They otherwise adopt the other creature's game statistics, though the target can't use this Soul Swap action.
The possession is undone if the target (while in the carrionette's body) deals damage to the carrionette (in the target's original body) with its Silver Needle. If either body is destroyed, both the carrionette and the target die.

special_abilities.name: Darklord Restoration
special_abilities.desc: If Chakuna dies and her heart remains intact, she revives with all her Hit Points in 1d10 weeks somewhere in Valachan. Chakuna's heart is a Tiny object that has AC 17, HP 10, and Immunity to all damage except Fire.

special_abilities.name: Experienced Hunter
special_abilities.desc: Difficult Terrain composed of undergrowth doesn't cost Chakuna extra movement.

special_abilities.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Domain)
special_abilities.desc: If Chakuna fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

special_abilities.name: Regional Effects
special_abilities.desc:
Valachan is altered by Chakuna's presence, creating the following effects.
Closing the Borders: While in her domain, Chakuna can close or open the borders to Valachan at will. While the borders are closed, shadowy beasts skulk or soar amid the Mists surrounding Valachan. A creature that enters the Mists for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there takes 1d10 Piercing damage.
Heightened Senses: Beasts and Monstrosities have Advantage on Wisdom checks.
Whispering Shadows: Humanoids subtract 1d8 from any ability checks they make when they take the Hide action.
If Chakuna dies, these effects end immediately.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Chakuna makes three attacks, using Scratch or Barbed Spear in any combination. She can replace one attack with a Bite attack.

actions.name: Bite (Panther or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.desc: m +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 20 (3d10 + 4) Piercing damage. If the target is a Humanoid, it is subjected to the following effect. con DC 15.  The target is cursed. If the cursed target drops to 0 Hit Points, it instead becomes a werepanther under the DM's control and has 10 Hit Points (use the Weretiger stat block).  The target is immune to Chakuna's curse for 24 hours.

actions.name: Scratch
actions.desc: m +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Barbed Spear (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.desc: m,r +8, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) Piercing damage and the target receives a dire wound if it doesn't have one. While the target is wounded, its speed is reduced by 10 feet, and it loses 5 (1d10) Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. The wound closes after 1 minute, after a spell restores Hit Points to the target, or after the target or a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to staunch the wound, doing so by succeeding on a DC 15 Wisdom (Medicine) check. The spear magically returns to Chakuna's hand immediately after a ranged attack.

legendary_actions.name: Pounce
legendary_actions.desc: Chakuna moves up to half her Speed and makes one Scratch attack.

legendary_actions.name: Strike from Shadows
legendary_actions.desc: Chakuna makes one Barbed Spear attack. If Chakuna has the Hide action's Invisible condition, this attack doesn't end that condition. Chakuna can't take this action again until the start of her next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Sudden Bite
legendary_actions.desc: Chakuna uses Shape-Shift to turn into her hybrid form or panther form and then makes one Bite attack. Chakuna can't take this action again until the start of her next turn.

special_abilities.name: Amphibious
special_abilities.desc: Cthulhu can breathe air and water.

special_abilities.name: Darklord Restoration
special_abilities.desc: If Cthulhu dies, it revives with all its Hit Points in 1d10 weeks inside the Vault of Cthulhu.

special_abilities.name: Impossible Geometry
special_abilities.desc: Ground, air, and water in a 10-foot Emanation originating from Cthulhu is Difficult Terrain. A creature that starts its turn in the Emanation takes 7 (2d6) Bludgeoning damage.

special_abilities.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day, or 5/Day in Domain)
special_abilities.desc: If Cthulhu fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: Cthulhu has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

special_abilities.name: Regional Effects
special_abilities.desc:
Innsmouth is altered by Cthulhu's presence, creating the following effects:
Choking Depths: A creature can hold its breath for only 30 seconds while in the domain.
Closing the Borders: While in its domain, Cthulhu can close or open the borders of Innsmouth at will. While the borders are closed, those who enter the Mists surrounding Innsmouth become lost at sea amid inky fog for 3d4 days before arriving once more at Innsmouth.
Something in the Air: Creatures other than Cthulhu and its allies have Disadvantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Frightened condition.
If Cthulhu dies, these effects end immediately.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Cthulhu makes three Eldritch Claw attacks and uses Spellcasting to cast Befuddlement if available or Mind Spike (level 4 version). It can replace one Eldritch Claw attack with a use of Tentacle.

actions.name: Eldritch Claw
actions.desc: m +17, reach 10 ft. Hit: 18 (2d8 + 9) Slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) Acid damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 19) from one of two limbs.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.desc: con DC 25, one creature Grappled by Cthulhu.  21 (6d6) Acid damage plus 13 (3d8) Psychic damage.  Half damage.  The target's Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the Psychic damage taken, and Cthulhu regains Hit Points equal to that amount.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
Cthulhu casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 25):
At will: Mind Spike (level 4 version)
3/day each: Dream, Geas (can target creatures through dreams)
1/day each: Befuddlement, Plane Shift (self only)

legendary_actions.name: Clamp
legendary_actions.desc: Cthulhu makes an Eldritch Claw attack.

legendary_actions.name: Fold Space
legendary_actions.desc: cha DC 25, each creature and object that isn't being worn or carried in a 10-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point Cthulhu can see within 60 feet.  36 (8d8) Force damage, and the target is teleported to an unoccupied space within 60 feet of Cthulhu that is horizontal to it.  Half damage only.  Cthulhu can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

special_abilities.name: Flyby
special_abilities.desc: The death's head doesn't provoke an Opportunity Attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: m +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage.

special_abilities.name: Overhanging Branches
special_abilities.desc: The tree's allies can willingly end their moves in the tree's space. Allies in the tree's space have Half Cover.

special_abilities.name: Unholy Regrowth
special_abilities.desc: If the tree dies, 2d6 Death's Head Trees regrow around the same place in 365 days unless the tree is killed by a creature under the effect of a Bless spell using a weapon that deals Slashing damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The tree makes two Slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: m +6, reach 10 ft. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Exploding Head
actions.desc: dex DC 14, each creature in a 10-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point the tree can see within 120 feet.  10 (3d6) Necrotic damage, and the creature has the Poisoned condition until the start of the tree's next turn.  Half damage only.

name: Dullahan
languages: understands Common plus one other language but can't speak

special_abilities.name: Mounted Adept
special_abilities.desc: While mounted and without the Incapacitated condition, the dullahan and its mount have Advantage on Dexterity saving throws, and the dullahan can force an attack targeted at its mount to target the dullahan instead.

special_abilities.name: Terrorizer
special_abilities.desc: The dullahan has Advantage on attack rolls against targets that have the Frightened condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The dullahan makes two attacks, using Beheading Blade or Fiery Skull in any combination, and uses Headless Wail.

actions.name: Beheading Blade
actions.desc: m +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) Slashing damage plus 11 (2d10) Necrotic damage. If the target is reduced to 0 Hit Points by this attack, it dies and its head is lopped off. The head rises as a Death's Head in the space of the target's corpse or in the nearest unoccupied space. The head is under the dullahan's control. The dullahan can control no more than seven heads at a time.

actions.name: Fiery Skull
actions.desc: r +7, range 120 ft. Hit: 18 (4d8) Fire damage.

actions.name: Headless Wail
actions.desc: con DC 15, up to three creatures within 120 feet of the dullahan that aren't Constructs or Undead.  13 (2d12) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the start of the dullahan's next turn.  Half damage only.

special_abilities.name: Darklord Restoration
special_abilities.desc: If Ebonbane dies, it revives with all its Hit Points in 1d10 weeks, teleporting somewhere in Shadowborn Manor. Until it revives, Ebonbane acts as a +3 Longsword when wielded by a creature.

special_abilities.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Domain)
special_abilities.desc: If Ebonbane fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: Ebonbane has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

special_abilities.name: Regional Effects
special_abilities.desc:
The Shadowlands is altered by Ebonbane's presence, creating the following effects:
Closing the Borders: While in its domain, Ebonbane can close or open the borders of the Shadowlands at will. While the borders are closed, whirling blades of magic fly through the Mists surrounding the Shadowlands. A creature that enters the Mists for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 3d10 Force damage. A creature makes this save only once per turn.
Haunted Woods: The forest within 1 mile of Ebonbane's lair is wreathed in a powerful illusion. Whenever a creature other than Ebonbane or the sword's allies finishes a Short or Long Rest in that area, it must succeed on a DC 15 Intelligence saving throw, or it is lost in the forest, always finding itself at the location it started in until it finishes a Short or Long Rest.
Turning Weapons: While in its lair, Ebonbane can transform nonmagical Greatswords and Longswords within 1 mile of the lair into Animated Flying Swords by completing a 24-hour ritual.
If Ebonbane is destroyed, these effects end immediately.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Ebonbane makes three Darkflame Slash attacks. It can replace one of these attacks with a use of Possess Dead if available.

actions.name: Darkflame Slash
actions.desc: m,r +9, reach 5 ft. or range 90 ft. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) Slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Possess Dead (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc:
Ebonbane raises a Medium or Small Humanoid corpse within 5 feet of itself and possesses it. The corpse wields Ebonbane and is under its control. Ebonbane gains 50 Temporary Hit Points, and its statistics are the same, except its Speed increases to 30 feet, and it can speak through the corpse using any language the corpse knew in life.
The possession lasts until Ebonbane drops to 0 Hit Points or Ebonbane ends the possession as a Bonus Action. Once the possession ends, Ebonbane can't possess the corpse again. The corpse crumbles to dust 24 hours after the possession ends.

actions.name: Worthy Wielder
actions.desc: cha DC 17, one willing Humanoid within 5 feet.  36 (8d8) Force damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 Hit Points, Ebonbane devours its soul. A creature whose soul has been devoured by Ebonbane can be restored to life only by a Wish spell.  The target attunes to Ebonbane and can wield the sword.

legendary_actions.name: Retaliate
legendary_actions.desc: Ebonbane moves up to half its Speed and makes one Darkflame Slash attack.

legendary_actions.name: Runic Flare
legendary_actions.desc: con DC 17, each creature of Ebonbane's choice in a 30-foot Emanation originating from Ebonbane.  The target has the Blinded condition and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns. The target succeeds automatically after 1 minute.  Ebonbane can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.desc: Ebonbane is hit by a melee attack roll.  Ebonbane adds 5 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The elder thing has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

special_abilities.name: Eldritch Magic (3/Day)
special_abilities.desc:
The elder thing casts Command, Detect Thoughts, Gust of Wind, or Nondetection, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 18).
3/day: Command, Detect Thoughts, Gust of Wind, Nondetection

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The elder thing makes two Soothing Tentacle attacks and uses Psychic Skewer.

actions.name: Soothing Tentacle
actions.desc: m +10, reach 10 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Psychic damage, and the target has the Charmed condition until the start of the elder thing's next turn.

actions.name: Mind-Scouring Spores (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: int DC 18, each creature in a 20-foot Emanation originating from the elder thing.  55 (10d10) Psychic damage. For 1 minute, whenever the target takes the Magic action, it takes 10 (3d6) Psychic damage.  Half damage only.

actions.name: Psychic Skewer
actions.desc: wis DC 18, one creature within 60 feet.  22 (4d10) Psychic damage. If the target has the Charmed condition, it gains 1 Exhaustion level and has the Stunned condition while Charmed.

special_abilities.name: Shield (3/Day)
special_abilities.desc:
Ez casts Shield in response to that spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.
3/day: Shield

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Ez makes three attacks, using Hunter's Blade or Fiery Bolt in any combination.

actions.name: Hunter's Blade
actions.desc: m +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) Piercing damage plus 11 (2d10) Radiant damage.

actions.name: Fiery Bolt
actions.desc: r +7, range 120 ft. Hit: 19 (3d10 + 3) Fire damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
Ez casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):
At will: Light, Mage Hand
1/day each: Dispel Evil and Good, Lightning Bolt, Magic Circle

special_abilities.name: Aura of Violence
special_abilities.desc: At the end of each of the gallows speaker's turns, each creature of the gallows speaker's choice in a 15-foot Emanation originating from the gallows speaker suffers the following effect. wis DC 15.  The target takes a Reaction to make a melee attack roll against a creature within reach. If no creature is within reach, the target takes 7 (2d6) Psychic damage.

special_abilities.name: Whirling Form
special_abilities.desc: The gallows speaker can enter a creature's space and stop there.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The gallows speaker makes two Whirling Blades attacks.

actions.name: Whirling Blades
actions.desc: m,r +6, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) Slashing damage plus 7 (3d4) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Howling Wind (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: con DC 15, each creature in a 30-foot Cone.  18 (4d8) Thunder damage, and the target has the Frightened condition for 1 minute. While Frightened in this way, the creature has the Deafened condition, is compelled to shriek along with the gallows speaker, and can't cast spells with a Verbal component. The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.  Half damage only.

special_abilities.name: Suppressed Lycanthropy
